svg.title: Мобилизация грудного отдела на ролле — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Thoracic extension mobility over a foam roller. True side view. Both feet flat and knees bent; pelvis stays on floor, ONE cylinder stays fixed under mid-upper back across torso and on floor, circular end visible. Hands cradle head in both panels. LEFT torso slightly curled, head raised. RIGHT chest arches back over the same unmoved roller, head moves backward and lower, elbows remain bent. No rolling movement, no bench. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
